system_prompts.app_greet: Greetings. This app is fully voice-controlled. To execute any action, start your speech with the word command. For example, say command, followed by help to hear available commands, or say command, followed by list books to get started.
system_prompts.help_general: To repeat the current speech, say command, followed by repeat. To return to the previous menu, say command, followed by go back. To close the application, say command, followed by exit.
system_prompts.not_implemented: This feature is coming soon. Let's go back.
system_prompts.exit_app: Exiting the app. Have a wonderful day!

book_session.resume_prompt: Book loaded. I have found a previous reading session. To continue where you left off, say command, followed by resume. To start from the beginning of the book, say command, followed by start over.
book_session.help_active_reader: Active reader help. To control playback, say command, followed by pause, play, or stop. To navigate, say command, followed by go forward, go back, or explain more. To hear this again, say command, followed by repeat.
book_session.no_audio_hyperlink: There are no additional explanations detected for the current text.

main_menu.intro: Main Menu. Please choose an option by saying command, followed by the number or title.
main_menu.help: Say command, followed by list books to browse textbooks, command, followed by upload to add new materials, command, followed by options for settings, or command, followed by exit to quit.

options.spoken_text: Option 2: Upload a book or audib data.
Option 3: Main app options and settings.

options_menu.intro: Settings Menu. Choose an option to change.
options_menu.help: Say command, followed by change voice, or command, followed by change speed.

options.spoken_text: Option 2: Change speech speed. Note that this requires an app restart.
